explication: PKHeX is a Windows Forms Pokémon save editor. A user opens a save, Pokémon entity, gift, or supported import; the application dispatches it into the save/entity editing environment, where slots and properties can be modified, legality can be checked, and data can be exported or written back. The tree and excerpts strongly show UI dispatch, slot manipulation, storage utilities, Go Park data, localization, and legality integration; several documented importers are represented only by their enclosing directories.
